content:
This mod is an addon for Extended Crafting.

It adds a new machine: Extended Quantum Compressor. Unlike the vanilla quantum compressor, this machine allows you to input an unlimited number of items in a single operation – regardless of stack size or total amount. Throw in 1 item, 10,000 items, or even more。
Furthermore, extended quantum compressor offers 4× energy storage and 2× compression speed by default(can be modified via configuration file).
